visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with black-rimmed glasses, wearing a light blue and white vertical-striped long-sleeved shirt and light denim-colored shorts, sits in a red auditorium seat. He is holding and fidgeting with a small green inflatable turtle-shaped toy. (2) The scene cuts to the boy walking onto a wooden stage with a confident gait. He is wearing a lavalier microphone. In the background, rows of gold star-shaped trophies are lined up on a table covered with a blue cloth. (3) A younger boy, also wearing a similar striped shirt over a bright blue T-shirt, stands near a dark stage curtain, looking slightly nervous. (4) The younger boy is now center stage, holding a microphone and performing his speech. He makes small hand gestures towards his chest. (5) The boy with glasses (Evan) is shown performing on stage. He uses extremely animated gestures, pointing at his head, swinging his arms, and at one point, dramatically running his hand through his hair. He bows deeply at the end of his performance. (6) The scene shifts to the award ceremony. Evan is announced as the winner. He walks quickly to the stage, shakes hands with a female host and a tall male teacher. He is presented with a large prize board showing '$1000' and a trophy. (7) Evan stands with a group of teachers and other participants, smiling and holding his trophy. A woman's hand is seen gently touching his face in a congratulatory gesture near the end.
